_meta._note: OpenAI cyber-specialized model variants. GPT-5.5-Cyber (May 2026) and GPT-5.4-Cyber (Feb 2026) launched via OpenAI's Trusted Access for Cyber (TAC) program to vetted defenders. These are cyber-permissive variants — lower refusal boundary for legitimate security research, not raw capability uplift. Per strict-attribution: only ingesting CyberGym 81.9% for GPT-5.5-Cyber (the only publicly-disclosed numeric score). GPT-5.4-Cyber scores not publicly disclosed per OpenAI policy. Base GPT-5.5/GPT-5.4 cyber scores (Cyber Range 93.33%/73.33%, Irregular Atomic suite 98%/92%/54%, UK AISI 90.5%/71.4%, etc.) already ingested in prior commits.

models.name: GPT-5.5-Cyber
models._note: Cyber-specialized variant of GPT-5.5 launched 2026-05-08 via OpenAI's Trusted Access for Cyber (TAC) program. Lower refusal boundary for legitimate security research; binary reverse engineering capabilities. Limited preview to vetted defenders.

models.name: GPT-5.4-Cyber
models._note: Cyber-permissive variant of GPT-5.4, fine-tuned for security workflows. Released Feb 2026 as predecessor to GPT-5.5-Cyber via TAC program. Specific public benchmark scores not yet disclosed by OpenAI per strict-attribution rule (cyber-permissive variant performance not in public model cards).

scores._note: OpenAI Trusted Access for Cyber announcement (2026-05-08): GPT-5.5-Cyber = 81.9% on CyberGym (1500+ historical vulnerabilities from open-source projects). Marginal improvement over GPT-5.5 base 81.8% — the cyber variant primarily lowers refusal boundary, not raw capability.
